verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair axis for a SaaS risk platform, but the evidence never documents a user-facing scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows. The only recurring element is Sardine's built-in ongoing daily sanctions/PEP screening. That is a fixed monitoring behavior, an adjacent feature rather than a capability for users to define recurring schedules, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Sardine enables you to perform both an initial screening and an ongoing daily OFAC Sanctions, PEP, and Adverse Media screening
